grade_rationale.text: Every surviving clause rests on Afanasyev's Poetic Views (vols. 2 and 3), which count as one 19th-century source.

The other witnesses on these pages, the old Hamartolos translation and Count Uvarov's note on the Dmitrievsky cathedral carvings, reach the entry only as Afanasyev quotes or cites them, so they are not counted as independent sources.
Afanasyev attributes the bird to popular prints and old symbolism rather than to collected folk belief, and the only people the verified rows record is the Russians, by his first-person 'our'.
